lines: Nothing is sent to the customer and no task is created by moving a job here by hand.
A new lead from the website form already got the new lead text when the form arrived.
Alert to the office: if no call is logged within 15 business minutes, the office gets an email. After 60 business minutes the owner gets a text and an email.
stops: The call reminders stop when a call is logged or the job leaves New Lead.

lines: Text to the customer: the missed call text, about 10 seconds after the move. It is sent once per lead, so moving the job out and back does not send it again.
Task for the office: second round of calls, due later today.
The contact's call attempts go up by 2 and the time of the attempt is saved.
stops: A reply from the customer or an answered call closes the second round of calls task.

lines: Email to the customer on day 2: the day 2 follow-up.
Email to the customer on day 4: pick a time to talk, with the booking link. Task for the office on day 4: one more call.
Email to the customer on day 7: closing this one off.
Day 8: if the job is still here with no reply, it is set to Lost with the reason Unreachable.
Emails go out between 8am and 8pm, Monday to Saturday.
stops: The emails stop when the customer replies on any channel, books a phone call, or the job leaves Dial 2.

lines: Nothing is sent to the customer.
The job is assigned to the owner. Alert to the owner by text and email: Assigned to you.
Task for the owner: write and send the quote. Residential is due in 2 business days. Commercial (scope and send the proposal) is due in 5 business days.
Any Dial 2 emails still waiting to go out are cancelled.
If the job is still here after the due time, it is listed under Quotes to write in the daily summary.
stops: The reminders stop when the quote is sent, or the job moves to Follow-Up, Nurture or Lost.

lines: Residential, now: email to the customer with the quote, and a text to the customer with the quote link.
Residential, after that, between 8am and 8pm Monday to Saturday: text on day 2, email on day 5 (why quotes differ), text on day 10, and a final close email on day 21.
Residential tasks for the office: call on day 2 to follow up the quote, and on day 21 decide: accepted, nurture or lost.
Commercial, now: email to the customer with the proposal. No text is sent.
Commercial, after that: follow-up emails on day 7 and day 21. Tasks for the owner: call within 2 days to confirm receipt, and on day 7 chase the decision date.
A revised quote (revision 2 or later) does not repeat the first quote email.
stops: The follow-up stops when the customer replies, accepts or declines, or the job leaves Quote Sent.
